## Weekly Maintenance Check

### Date
Week of: <!-- e.g., Jan 15-21, 2025 -->

### Claude Maintenance Tasks
@claude please perform the following weekly maintenance tasks:

## 1. Dependency Check
- [ ] Check for outdated dependencies with security updates
- [ ] Identify major version updates that might need attention
- [ ] Suggest safe updates that won't break functionality

## 2. Code Quality Review
- [ ] Find unused imports across the codebase
- [ ] Identify dead code that can be removed
- [ ] Check for console.log statements that should be removed
- [ ] Find TODO/FIXME comments that need addressing

## 3. Performance Optimization
- [ ] Identify potential performance bottlenecks
- [ ] Check for inefficient algorithms or data structures
- [ ] Review API route response times
- [ ] Suggest caching improvements

## 4. Error Handling Audit
- [ ] Review error messages for clarity
- [ ] Check for unhandled promise rejections
- [ ] Verify all try-catch blocks are properly implemented
- [ ] Ensure user-friendly error messages

## 5. TypeScript Health
- [ ] Check for any 'any' types that should be properly typed
- [ ] Verify all functions have proper return types
- [ ] Look for missing interface definitions
- [ ] Check for type assertion overuse

## 6. Documentation Check
- [ ] Identify functions missing JSDoc comments
- [ ] Check if README is up to date with latest features
- [ ] Verify environment variable documentation

## 7. Testing Coverage
- [ ] Identify critical functions without tests
- [ ] Suggest areas needing test coverage
- [ ] Check for broken or outdated tests
